skill.name: test-ops
skill.description: Standardizes test planning, implementation, and reporting workflows.
skill.summary: Guidance for consistent test design, mocking, execution checks, and reporting.
skill.author: A-Genno

security_audit.summary: The only static finding was an entropy heuristic on SKILL.md. Review found normal UTF-8 markdown guidance for test planning, mocking, implementation, and reporting, with no obfuscation or prompt injection.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.69 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is readable UTF-8 markdown with Japanese test guidance, not binary or encrypted content. The entropy score is explained by non-ASCII prose rather than obfuscation.

content.value_statement: Test planning can become inconsistent across features and teams. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a concise framework for designing, mocking, implementing, and reporting tests.
actual_capabilities: Defines test design principles for normal, error, boundary, and edge cases.
Promotes independent, readable, and maintainable test cases.
Provides mocking guidance for databases, APIs, time, and file I/O.
Outlines implementation steps from feature analysis to coverage review.
Sets quality criteria for AAA structure, test names, assertions, and failure messages.
limitations: Does not include runnable scripts or tool integrations.
Does not define framework-specific commands or fixtures.
Does not automatically measure coverage or execute tests.
Requires project context to produce detailed test cases.

use_cases.title: Plan Feature Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Create a balanced test plan with normal, error, boundary, and edge cases before implementation.

use_cases.title: Design Reliable Mocks
use_cases.description: Identify external dependencies and replace them with stable mocks or fixtures for repeatable tests.

use_cases.title: Review Test Quality
use_cases.description: Check whether test names, assertions, failure messages, and coverage goals support long-term maintenance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Test Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a test plan for [feature]. Include normal, error, boundary, and edge cases.

prompt_templates.title: Design Mocking Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design mocks for [component] that uses [database, API, time, or files]. Keep the tests independent and readable.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for test quality feedback.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing test approach for [module]. Identify missing cases, brittle dependencies, and clearer assertions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Test Operations Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for team-level process guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a test operations checklist for [project]. Include design principles, implementation sequence, coverage review, and reporting criteria.

output_examples.input: Plan tests for a user registration flow.
output_examples.output: A concise test matrix covering successful signup, invalid email, duplicate account, weak password, missing fields, and boundary-length inputs.

output_examples.input: Improve tests for a payment component that calls an external API.
output_examples.output: A mocking plan for approved, declined, timeout, malformed response, and retry scenarios, with stable assertions for each path.

output_examples.input: Review a team test checklist before release.
output_examples.output: A quality review that checks independence, AAA structure, readable names, useful failure messages, and coverage gaps.

best_practices: Ask for normal, error, boundary, and edge cases in every test plan.
Mock external systems and time-dependent behavior for repeatable tests.
Request clear assertions and failure messages during test design.
anti_patterns: Asking for tests without describing expected behavior and edge cases.
Using real external services in routine automated test plans.
Treating coverage percentage as a substitute for meaningful assertions.

faq.question: Does this skill run tests?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning and implementation guidance. You run tests with your project tools.

faq.question: Can it help with APIs and databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for mocking HTTP clients, repositories, and fixture-based data access.

faq.question: Is it tied to one test framework?
faq.answer: No. The guidance is framework-neutral and can be adapted to common test runners.

faq.question: Can it help write test code?
faq.answer: It can guide test structure, cases, and assertions. Generated code depends on the project context.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill text contains guidance only and does not perform network operations.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
